tz: dates are in the ad account timezone as returned by Meta
note: Per-piece delivery of the clearance catalog campaign (name contains 'LAST PIECES'), Meta breakdowns=product_id, DAILY. Key = retailer_id (the 'id' column of the Odoo feed /liq/feed.csv). products[id] = list of [date, impressions, clicks]; days with no delivery are omitted. Odoo (deniz_clearance) sums them from the start of a piece's ladder step: seen >= 500 impressions or >= 8 clicks, unseen < 150. Refreshed every 3 h; error!=null keeps the last good data.
